name: Dunnet Bay Escapes
accommodation: Guest rooms in the main house plus two garden suites with kitchenettes, all en suite
beachAccess: Beach described as at the bottom of the garden
confirmedFeatures: Hot tub, garden terrace, breakfast with homemade baking, free Wi-Fi, smart TVs
overview: Dunnet Bay Escapes is a bed and breakfast in Dunnet, set in private grounds with views over the bay and Dunnet Head. It has en-suite guest rooms and two garden suites with kitchenettes. The owners describe the beach as at the bottom of the garden, and there is a hot tub for guests.
surfTripFit: With the beach at the end of the garden, you can walk straight down to surf and come back to a hot tub.
